name: Urma Lite (always-on DCA)

source.label: Urma Lite, a low-cost always-on DCA bot shared on the Gainium community forum (based on TradeAlts' ASAP DCA bots)

rules: Open a deal as soon as the coin has none, whatever the price.
Average down with up to 7 safety orders the same size as the first order, the first 1.87% lower, each 1.5 times further and 1.4 times larger than the one before.
Sell the whole position 3% above its average price.
Hold one deal per coin at a time, with no stop loss.
notExpressed: Running it on many altcoin pairs at once (the test runs BTC, ETH and SOL)
